newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-'RUDE' STEWARD FACES CENSURE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-'RUDE' STEWARD FACES CENSURE.

text.p: The English Jockey Club have received a formal letter of complaint from a television executive ordered to "take your hands out of your pockets" by a senior steward at York racecourse.

John Jenyns, chairman of York stewards, has been accused of "outrageous arrogance and extreme discourtesy" after instructing John Fairley and Andrew Franklin of Channel Four racing to remain standing during a half-hour meeting on Tuesday.
Sir Thomas Pilkington, senior steward at the Jockey Club, said he was "very concerned" about the conduct of Jenyns, pictured at York on Thursday with his own hand thrust deep into his left pocket.
